translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Esegielehanda dugu daraore bia henego ogo
Anduane Homogo ibugua i̱hondo lalu, Isaraele kinibi Yuda kinibi libunaga dugu daraore bia halu iba gana ogobi labe, laya.

content.text: Í̠ ai̱ya ibu gabua laiono timbuniore hene.
Ibugua laiono wangabe dewa bu hearu ti dege dombeneha howa
ibu iginiru bayuwa handayaho hayagola ti bayale anda hai haya.
Ibu igini mbiraore wangabe timbuni anda hayagola
ibugua igini ogoni nogo tara tara gabua taya helo biawai haya.
Ibu laiono hongoheore howa agalibi bo nagane helo biawai haya.
Hameigini tara tara dindi tarani bu hearume laiono ogonime mana biaga ngago hale hai haya.
Tigua ibalu laiononaga gundu uli tombo wiyagola laiono uli ogoniha pilaya.
Tigua ibu ne harigaha wena langame helowa Iyibi dindiha gililo yalu piya.
Ai̱yahanda ibu igini dai bilo maliaho biraabo heagola igini biago dai nabiya.
Dai nabiya handala ibu igini dege mende heago
ibu laiono dalua bayale dege helo dabo helene.
Laiono igini ogoni andaho heagola
ibu laiono maru hearu baba mandagi ibaga bu haya.
Ibugua nogo tara tararu bolene mana bu manda bialu howa
nogo gabua tara tara taya bialu agalibi bo nagane dege hene.
Ibugua tinaga wai pabe anda hongohe hearubi
tano wiarubi bo gialo wahai haga bialu hene.
Ibugua bi hongo howa layagola
wali agali bibahende hearume gi hai haga hene.
Hameigini tara tara dindi tara wiaruha howa laiono ogoni baba wai bule íbu ngoai hene.
Tigua gono wiago mo tigabu ngelo howa
gonoha dayagola hadene.
Tigua ibu wena langame hende howa
mbogoyi mbiraha minu berelowa Babilono kini hearia yalu pene.
Ibu pora bialu tagira napelo
ibu garabaya anda hongohe wiagoha helo helene.
Wali agali Isaraele dindi hari ngaruha hearume
ibunaga bi hongo howa laruane lone hale nahelo ani bini.
Kini ogonilabo libu ai̱ya ibu pu mbira lini daga mini gerebi
iba angeni hengene mbira haraligobi bereneya.
Pu gerebi ogoni iba bayale bereagoria hengenego
timbuni anda howa gene maganeni yuni dewahe gerebi linibi dewaore deneya.
Pu gerebi ogoninaga gene magane hongoheore halu
kininaga halimbu hongohe ngaligobi haya.
Irane ogoni luniore halu hari beraliba ela habehe haya.
Ibu luniore halu magane yunibi timbuni dewaorebi heago
bibahende hearume de handai hene.
Pu gerebi ogonibi heagola agali bu hearume keba howa
irane ogoni minu dugualu dindini bape haya.
Tigua ani biyagola ni tagira ibiragohayagi howa
puyabu poboyogobi ibiyagome gerebi lini deago bibahende yogo bialu gaulai haya.
Agali urunime ira magane hearu dandape hai halu
magane bibahende irani delai haya.
Mani tigua pu gerebi ogoni dugu yalu puwa
dindi ko yobini iba nabiraga wiagoha hangaya.
Ogoninaga teneha howa
ira datagi halu gene magane yuni linibi irame dai haya.
Ibunaga magane bayale mbira hongohe ndo howa
kininaga halimbu wabibehe mbira naheneya.

content: Bi ogoni dugu daraore binigo tigua iba gana lalu haabo haga winigo nga.
